component.name: RecentItem
component.script: sub onContent() m.top.findNode("lbl").text = m.top.itemContent.title end sub sub onFocus() if m.top.gridHasFocus and m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 then m.top.findNode("bg").color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.top.findNode("lbl").color = "0x0A0A0AFF" else m.top.findNode("bg").color = "0x00000000" m.top.findNode("lbl").color = "0xB8BBC0FF" end if end sub
